# Reference indentation, produced by Emacs `typelisp-mode`.
#
# Captured by running `indent-region` over each input in a `typelisp-mode`
# buffer, so the expected side is not a transcription of what the TypeScript
# indenter happens to do -- it is what the other editor actually produces.
# Regenerate by re-running that in Emacs if the shared indent rules change.

=== let binding body
--- input
(defun f ((n i32)) i32
(let ((a 1))
(setf a 2)
a))
--- expected
(defun f ((n i32)) i32
  (let ((a 1))
    (setf a 2)
    a))

=== if lines up both branches
--- input
(defun g ((x i32)) i32
(if (< x 0)
(- 0 x)
x))
--- expected
(defun g ((x i32)) i32
  (if (< x 0)
      (- 0 x)
      x))

=== pub defun with match
--- input
(pub defun h ((x i32)) i32
(match x
(0 1)
(_ 2)))
--- expected
(pub defun h ((x i32)) i32
  (match x
    (0 1)
    (_ 2)))

=== impl member body
--- input
(impl Shape rect
(label ((self Self)) string
(append "a"
"b")))
--- expected
(impl Shape rect
  (label ((self Self)) string
    (append "a"
            "b")))

=== labels local function
--- input
(defun k () i32
(labels
((go ((n i32)) i32
(if (= n 0)
0
(go (- n 1)))))
(go 3)))
--- expected
(defun k () i32
  (labels
      ((go ((n i32)) i32
         (if (= n 0)
             0
             (go (- n 1)))))
    (go 3)))

=== defstruct fields
--- input
(defstruct point
(x f64)
(y f64))
--- expected
(defstruct point
  (x f64)
  (y f64))

=== module body
--- input
(module m
(defun q () i32 1))
--- expected
(module m
  (defun q () i32 1))

=== dotimes body
--- input
(defun r () ()
(dotimes (i 3)
(println "~d" i)))
--- expected
(defun r () ()
  (dotimes (i 3)
    (println "~d" i)))

=== cond with else
--- input
(defun s () ()
(cond
((< 1 2) ())
(else ())))
--- expected
(defun s () ()
  (cond
    ((< 1 2) ())
    (else ())))

=== do stepping
--- input
(defun t2 () ()
(do ((a 0 (+ a 1)))
((= a 3) ())
(println "~d" a)))
--- expected
(defun t2 () ()
  (do ((a 0 (+ a 1)))
      ((= a 3) ())
    (println "~d" a)))

=== quoted forms align with their prefix
--- input
(defun u () Sexpr
(append '(1 2)
'(3 4)))
--- expected
(defun u () Sexpr
  (append '(1 2)
          '(3 4)))

=== pprint-logical-block
--- input
(defun v () ()
(pprint-logical-block (o :prefix "[")
(pprint-newline :fill)))
--- expected
(defun v () ()
  (pprint-logical-block (o :prefix "[")
    (pprint-newline :fill)))

=== let* sequential bindings
--- input
(defun w () i32
(let* ((a 1)
(b 2))
(+ a b)))
--- expected
(defun w () i32
  (let* ((a 1)
         (b 2))
    (+ a b)))

=== doiter body
--- input
(defun x2 ((v Vector<i32>)) ()
(doiter (e (iter v))
(println "~d" e)))
--- expected
(defun x2 ((v Vector<i32>)) ()
  (doiter (e (iter v))
    (println "~d" e)))

=== defvar continuation
--- input
(defvar (*flag* bool)
false)
--- expected
(defvar (*flag* bool)
  false)
